Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:10:1.hebrew: למען תפוש - שתפשו בלבם הרהורי עבודת כוכבים, דבה משתעי קרא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:10:1.english: So I may take - That they harbored in their heart thoughts of idol worship, for it is of it that Scripture speaks.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:12:1.hebrew: והאמר רבי אלעזר כו' - והיכי אמרי' דרבי יעקב מעשה חזא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:12:1.english: But didn’t Rabbi Elazar say, etc. - And how can we say that Rabbi Ya’akov saw an [actual] incident?

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:12:2.hebrew: איך אלך - ואע"ג דבשליחותא דמקום הוה, מסתפי מהזיקא דקביעא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:12:2.english: How will I go - And even though he was on a mission of the Omnipresent, he was afraid of an established danger.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:13:1.hebrew: אלמלי דרשיה אחר להאי קרא - דלמען ייטב לך בעולם הבא, לא חטא. דאיהו נמי כה"ג חזא, אמר: "אין שכר בעולם!", ויצא לתרבות רעה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:13:1.english: Had Aḥer interpreted this verse - [As meaning] that "that it may go well with you" [is] in the World-to-Come, he would not have sinned. For he, too, saw a case like this, [and] said, "There is no reward in the world!" and went astray.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:14:2.hebrew: והאמר רבי אלעזר כו' - והיכי אמרי' דרבי יעקב מעשה חזא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:14:2.english: But didn’t Rabbi Elazar say, etc. - And how can we say that Rabbi Ya’akov saw an [actual] incident?

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:15:1.hebrew: התם שבא דבר עבירה לידו - ההוא ישב ולא עבר עבירה, דקאמר נוטל עליה שכר — בעבירה שבא לידו וכפה יצרו ולא עבר. אין מצוה יתירה מזו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:15:1.english: There, where a sinful act presents itself to him - That [case of] "one sat and did not commit a transgression," where it says [that] he receives a reward for it, [is referring to] a transgression that presented itself to him and he subdued his [evil] inclination and did not transgress — [for] there is no greater mitzvah than this.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:16:1.english: She solicited him - To engage in illicit relations.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:16:3.english: They would be harmed - For demons were common in it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:1:1.hebrew: ארבע מד' רוחות הערוגה - אם היה זורען בערוגה אחת, ונשמר להניח ריוח ביניהם שלא יינקו זה מזה כמשפטם השנויה במס' שבת (דף פד:) — הוה שמעינן מינה שאסור לזרוע כלאים בח"ל. אבל השתא דזרע כל מין בערוגה לבדו, לאו משום כלאים הוא, אלא שלא להטריח השמש שהולך להביא ירק לבקש מין שהוא צריך לו בין שאר המינין, ויודע באיזה ערוגה הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:1:1.english: Four along the four sides of the garden bed - If he had sown them in a single garden bed and had been careful to leave space between them so that they would not draw sustenance from one another, according to their rule as taught in tractate Shabbat (84b), we would have inferred from this that it is forbidden to sow diverse kinds outside the Land [of Israel]. But now that he sowed each species in a bed of its own, it was not on account of diverse kinds, but rather so as not to trouble the attendant who goes to fetch vegetables [by having] to search for the species that he needs among the other species, and [instead] he will know in which bed it is.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:2:1.english: One who performs one mitzva - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:2:2.english: Goodness is bestowed upon him - [This] implies in this world.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:2:3.english: And he inherits the land - The life of the World-to-Come.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:3:1.hebrew: אלו דברים כו' - הני הוא דאוכל פירות והקרן קיימת, אבל מצוה אחריתי — לא; ואנן תנן: מטיבין לו ונוחל את הארץ:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:3:1.english: These are the matters, etc. - It is [only for] these that [a person] eats the fruits and the principal remains, but [for] another mitzvah, [he does] not; yet we learned [in our Mishnah]: "Goodness is bestowed upon him, and he inherits the land."

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:4:1.hebrew: מכלל דהני אפילו חדא נמי - ואפילו לא קיים שאר מצות? (בתמיה) — והא רובא עונות הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:4:1.english: By inference, that [for] these, even for one as well - And [does it mean] even if he did not fulfill the rest of the mitzvot? [This is asked] in astonishment — for behold, the majority [of his deeds] are sins!

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:4:2.hebrew: לומר שאם היתה שקולה מכרעת - הא דקתני אלו דברים, במחצה עונות ומחצה זכיות קאמר: ויש במחצה זכיות אחת מאלו — מכרעת את הכף, כאילו הוי רובא זכיות, ואינו צריך למצוה יתירה דמתני'. וכי לית ליה בה חדא מהני — צריך למצוה יתירה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:4:2.english: To say that if it was equally balanced, it tilts [the scale] - That which [the mishna] teaches, 'These are the things' — it is speaking of [a person with] half sins and half merits: and [if] there is among the half [that is] merits one of these [mitzvot], it tilts the scale, as if it were a majority of merits, and he does not need an additional mitzvah of our mishna. And when he does not have among them one of these [mitzvot], he needs an additional mitzvah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:5:1.hebrew: מריעין לו - בעוה"ז, לנקותו מעונותיו, שיטול שכר שלם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:5:1.english: Harm is done to him - In this world, to cleanse him of his sins, so that he will receive a full reward [in the World-to-Come].

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:5:2.english: Goodness is bestowed upon him - To pay him the reward for his mitzvot in his lifetime, in order to banish him [from the World-to-Come].

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:6:1.hebrew: מתני' - דקתני מטיבין ומריעין, דעבדין ליה יום טב ויום ביש. מי שעושה מצוה יתירה, דהוי רובא זכיות — מתקנין לו בעולם הזה י"ט, שנפרעים ממנו עונותיו, וזהו תקון י"ט לו לעולם הבא. וכל שעונותיו מרובין, דקתני מריעין לו — היינו דעבדין ליה הזמנת יום ביש, שמשלמין לו שכר מצותיו כאן, להיות מתוקן לו יום רע:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:6:1.english: The Mishnah - That which it teaches, 'good is done [to him]' and 'harm is done [to him],' [means] that they make for him a good day and a bad day. One who performs an extra mitzvah, such that the majority [of his deeds] are merits — they prepare for him in this world a good day, in that his sins are exacted from him, and this is the preparation of a good day for him in the World-to-Come. And anyone whose sins are many, [of whom] it is taught, 'harm is done to him' — this is [the meaning of] 'they make for him the preparation of a bad day,' in that they pay him the reward of his mitzvot here, so that a bad day is prepared for him [in the World-to-Come].

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:6:2.hebrew: רבא אמר - לעולם כדאמרן מעיקרא: מטיבין לו בשכר פירות והקרן קיימת; והך מתני' דקתני מריעין לו — רבי יעקב היא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:6:2.english: Rava said - Actually, [the mishna is] as we said initially: "has goodness bestowed upon him" [means] through the reward of the fruits, and the principal remains [for the World-to-Come]; and that teaching which teaches "suffering is inflicted upon him" is [the view of] Rabbi Ya'akov.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:7:1.hebrew: שאין תחיית המתים תלויה - באותו מתן שכר, להודיעך שאין מתן שכר אלא לעולם הבא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:7:1.english: That the resurrection of the dead is not dependent - [Meaning, dependent] upon that reward, to inform you that there is no reward except in the World to Come.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:9:1.hebrew: ודלמא לא הוה הכי - לא יארע הדבר הזה לעולם, אלא מאריכין ימיו ושנותיו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:9:1.english: And perhaps it was not so - Such a thing would never occur; rather, his days and years are lengthened.

Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:9:2.hebrew: ודלמא אותה שעה מהרהר בעבירה היה - ולא היה לבו לשמים. ומשני: מחשבה רעה, ומעשה לא עשה — אין הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה, ולא היה לו ללקות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 39b:9:2.english: And perhaps at that time he was contemplating sin - And his heart was not [directed] toward Heaven. And [the Gemara] answers: [As for] a bad thought, where he did not perform an action — the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not combine it with an action, and he should not have been punished.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:4:1.hebrew: שאם היתה שקולה מכרעת - וא"ת: בלאו הכי נמי אמרי' במסכת ר"ה (דף יז.), דרב חסד מטה כלפי חסד כשהן שקולין? וי"ל: דבשאר מצות, כשמעשיו שקולים, הוי כבינוני; אבל בהני, חשיב צדיק גמור:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:4:1.english: "That if it were equally balanced, it tilts [the scale]" - And if you say: Even without this, do we not also say in Tractate Rosh Hashanah (17a) that "[He Who is] abundant in kindness" tilts [the scale] toward kindness when they are equally balanced? And one can say: With other mitzvot, when his deeds are equally balanced, he is [treated] as an intermediate [beinoni]; but with these [mitzvot], he is considered completely righteous [tzaddik gamur].

Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:6:1.hebrew: מתניתין דעבדין ליה יום טב ויום ביש - פי' בקונט': מי שעושה מצוה יתירה, דהוי רובא זכיות, מתקנין לו בעולם הזה יום טוב ונפרעים ממנו עונותיו, וזהו תיקון י"ט לו לעה"ב. וכל שעונותיו מרובים, דקתני "מריעין לו" — היינו דעבדינן ליה הזמנת יום ביש, שמשלמין לו שכר מצותיו כאן, להיות מתוקן לו יום רע. "רבא אמר" — פירוש: לעולם כדאמרן מעיקרא, מטיבין לו בשכר פירות והקרן קיימת; והך מתניתין דקתני "מריעין לו" — רבי יעקב היא, דאמר: שכר מצות כו'. וקשה: דמשני "הא מני רבי יעקב היא", משמע דעד השתא לא אוקמינן כרבי יעקב; ולפי' הקונט', לאביי נמי בין מתניתין בין ברייתא אתי כרבי יעקב! לכך פי' ר"ת: מתני' דעבדין ליה יום טוב ויום ביש — ותרוייהו בעולם הזה; ומטיבין לו דברייתא הוי פירוש אמתני', כלומר: פעמים שעושין לו יום טוב כדי לקבל שכר מצותיו בעולם הזה, ובאותו יום יהא דומה לו כמו שקיים כל התורה כולה; אבל רוב ימיו של רשע שרוי ברעה, והיינו שעונותיו מרובין על זכיותיו. ו"מריעין לו" — היינו פעמים שעושין לו יום רע כדי למרק עונותיו בעולם הזה, ובאותו יום יהא דומה לו כמי ששרף כל התורה; אבל רוב ימיו של צדיק שרוי בטובה כשזכיותיו מרובין על עונותיו. והיינו דלא כר' יעקב, דאמר: שכר מצוה בהאי עלמא ליכא כלל:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:6:1.english: "The mishna [means] that they make for him a good day and a bad day" - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained: [Regarding] one who performs an additional mitzvah, such that [his deeds become] a majority of merits, they prepare for him in this world a good day, and exact payment from him for his sins [through suffering], and this is the preparation of a good day for him in the World-to-Come. And [as for] anyone whose sins are a majority, concerning whom it is taught, "they bring evil upon him" — this means that they make for him the preparation for a bad day, in that they pay him the reward of his mitzvot here [in this world], so that a bad day is prepared for him [in the World-to-Come]. [As for the statement,] "Rava said" — the explanation is: Actually, [it is] as we said originally, [that] "they do good to him" with the reward of the fruits while the principal remains [for the World-to-Come]; and this teaching that taught "they bring evil upon him" is [in accordance with] Rabbi Ya'akov, who said that [there is no] reward of mitzvot [in this world], etc. And this is difficult: For when [Rava] resolves [the contradiction by saying], "In accordance with whose [opinion] is this? It is Rabbi Ya'akov," this implies that until now [under Abaye] we did not establish [the text] in accordance with Rabbi Ya'akov; yet according to the explanation of the Kuntres, according to Abaye as well, both the mishna and the baraita follow Rabbi Ya'akov! Therefore Rabbeinu Tam explained: The mishna [means] that they make for him a good day and a bad day — and both of them are in this world. And [the statement] "they do good to him" of the baraita is an explanation of the mishna; that is to say: Sometimes they make for him a good day in order [for him] to receive the reward of his mitzvot in this world, and on that day he appears as though he fulfilled the entire Torah; but most of a wicked person's days are spent in misfortune, and that is [the case] where his sins exceed his merits. And "they bring evil upon him" — this means [that there are] times they make for him a bad day in order to purge his sins in this world, and on that day he appears like one who burned the entire Torah; but most of a righteous person's days are spent in goodness when his merits exceed his sins. And this is not in accordance with [the opinion of] Rabbi Ya'akov, who said that there is no reward for a mitzvah in this world at all.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:9:1.hebrew: מחשבה רעה אין הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה - ובעובדי עבודת כוכבים איפכא: מחשבה רעה — הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה, דכתיב (עובדיה א׳:י׳): "מחמס אחיך יעקב תכסך בושה ונכרת לעולם". ולא מצינו שעשה עשו ליעקב שום רעה, אלא מחשבתו הרעה אשר חשב עליו מצרפה הקב"ה למעשה. ומחשבה טובה של עובדי כוכבים אין הקב"ה מצרפה למעשה, כדכתיב בדניאל (ודריוש): "עד מעלי שמשא הוה משתדר לשיזבותיה". פירוש: שהיה דריוש עושה כל כחו להציל דניאל מגוב אריות; אלמא, אע"ג שהצילו עד הערב, קאמר קרא שלא הצילו אלא מבקש להצילו, מדכתיב לשיזבותי' ולא כתב "ושיזביה":
Tosafot on Kiddushin 39b:9:1.english: "The Holy One, Blessed be He, does not link an evil thought to an action" - And regarding idolaters, it is the opposite: An evil thought, the Holy One, Blessed be He, links to an action, as it is written (Obadiah 1:10): "For violence against your brother Jacob shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off forever." And we do not find that Esau did any harm to Jacob; rather, his evil thought that he contemplated against him, the Holy One, Blessed be He, linked to an action. And a good thought of idolaters, the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not link to an action, as it is written in Daniel: "(and Darius) until sunset was striving to save him." Explanation: Darius was doing everything in his power to save Daniel from the lions' den; thus, even though he had protected him until evening, Scripture states that he did not save him, but only sought to save him, since it is written "to save him" [lisheizavuteih] and it did not write "and he saved him" [vesheizveih].
